video_title: Boogie - The Sixers are the TEAM to Beat in the NBA! Can Philly Have 4 All-Stars This Year?!

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Philadelphia 76ers are currently the most consistent and dominant team
quotes.excerpt: They've separated themselves from the pack in this early season so far. They've been the most consistent.
quotes.quote: They've separated themselves from the pack in this early season so far. They've been the most consistent. They've shown to be the most dominant so far, and you can't credit this group enough as far as how quickly they've come together, how quickly they've gained chemistry. It looks like a group that has one goal in mind, which is competing for a championship at the end of the year.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Philadelphia 76ers' strong start and defensive performance
quotes.excerpt: They don't turn the ball over. They're first in the fewest amount of turnovers.
quotes.quote: They don't turn the ball over. They're first in the fewest amount of turnovers. And this team with that roster, I didn't think they'd be the number three defense in the NBA. So they've all bought in, they're all playing their roles. We know offensively they have so much firepower, but we didn't think that we would know how quickly they would mesh.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.excerpt: This Maxey crew, we are here as complementary pieces to him.
quotes.quote: I thought last year the Sixers were in a pretty good spot to continue on and do what they were doing. And then you add Jaylen Brown and you add LeBron James to it. At first you are like that might be a little too much, it might be some egos, it might be some issues. It's the perfect storm. Jaylen Brown has come to this team, he just said it, this Maxey crew, we are here as complementary pieces to him. I think that's the right thing to say, I think that's the right mentality to have. It started as Joel and Embiid's group, they put as many complementary pieces and players around him as they could. You bring in Maxey as part of that, Maxey turns the corner and he turns into this star. He's healthy, he's the youngest guy. Let's play at his pace.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Philadelphia 76ers' defensive versatility and matchup nightmares
quotes.excerpt: John Collins never had to guard a LeBron James like he's never had to deal with anything.
quotes.quote: My man John Collins is his matchup. John Collins never had to guard a LeBron James like he's never had to deal with anything like that. In Chicago, you got guys like Buzelis and Jaylen Smith, they're guarding LeBron James. That just creates a nightmare for teams. And when you're focused on that, when you got guys kind of mismatched at the four and the five because of LeBron James, you still have to deal with the guard play. So I think these guys caught the perfect storm.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Philadelphia 76ers' potential for multiple All-Star selections
quotes.excerpt: Let's say they go into the break with 25, 30 plus wins. We might see three or four.
quotes.quote: Let's say they go into the break with 25, 30 plus wins. We might see three or four of these guys represented. LeBron James is going to be grandfathered in. I think this is the first year that I feel like, okay, maybe. But if them guys go in there 25 plus, 30 wins, going into that break, and LeBron James is doing his part, he is for sure going to get voted in by these coaches.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's status as a starter in All-Star game
quotes.excerpt: I think that's the only way he'll get in as far as being a starter.
quotes.quote: I think that's the only way he'll get in as far as being a starter, which is not as you said it, I think that's a high chance thing that he gets in as a starter. This is still LeBron James. Let's not get it twisted.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey as the leading scorer for the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: Maxey is their going to be their leading scorer, but that might not make him their best player.
quotes.quote: I think when you look at this team too, they're so good and so talented, I think we all can agree that Maxey is their going to be their leading scorer, but that might not make him their best player. Is that fair? Like Jaylen Brown might there be their most complete player, a two-way player, versatile player. Joel and Embiid can still be the most dominant player. So again, there's so many aspects of this offense where it's a good problem to have, but I think it's safe to say that Tyrese Maxey will lead their team in scoring.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Philadelphia as the best landing spot for LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: For LeBron, I think it was the best situation as far as him wanting to still compete.
quotes.quote: For LeBron, I think it was the best situation as far as him wanting to still compete this late in his career, still strive for greatness. I think this was the perfect situation. I mean we look at Miami, they're still figuring things out. Golden State is rolling. I don't necessarily know how that fit would have worked in Golden State to be honest. And then with the Lakers, I think that chapter just closed on both ends. The bridge was burned. So I never thought it was really a chance for him to return to the Lakers. But I think this was the perfect situation.
